limits: Conservative purchased outlines are not complete OEM material models. Their positive intersections are envelope conflicts, not automatically a proven physical collision.
Caliper/rotor projections without controlled 3D geometry are excluded from physical overlap acceptance.
The nine regular journal-admissible axle poses, one captured-extension maintenance pose and sampled yaw/body roll/wear offsets are not a continuous sweep.
No manufacturing tolerances, flexure, heat, hose flexibility, tool ergonomics or stock supplier interchangeability are accepted by this geometry run.
Flexible hose shapes are reviewed only at nominal pose. No moving-hose collision or bend-radius pass is implied.
Retained axle2 context includes upright translated boxes and tilted shaft/wheels. Other truck axle, coil deformation and detailed damper articulation are outside this run.
Only one brake location is represented. Remaining handed installations and air circuits are not accepted.

verified_bounded_findings.finding: 154/154 checkpoint shapes are valid. The geometry and checker hashes remained unchanged during the run.

317 nominal exact pair tests found zero unresolved custom-material overlaps. The 40 positives comprise 36 explicit screw-major-cylinder/tap-drill representations and four purchased fitting/chamber/hose envelope junctions.
The relocated HSS clears the actual retained pivot cup. Tube top Z 400.8 is 13.9 mm below cup minimum Z 414.7; this nominal separation is not a tolerance allowance.
Both endplates share 19,348.8 mm² with the actual C5 inner side webs, the full 166.8×116 mm rectangle. This establishes backing, not weld strength or accessible weld length.

Ten finite-link poses close within 5.7×10⁻¹⁴ mm: nine regular journal-admissible poses and a separate zero-roll −60 mm captured maintenance pose. 1239 exact moving-pair tests found no custom-part interference.

The represented rigid parts had no positive intersections with 276 retained fixed C5 shapes or 82 body shapes in the sampled yaw, body-roll and wear cases. Checks against 63 axle 2 shapes found only 10 new-key/uncut-axle witness intersections.
The corrected 0250 port vector is 300° clockwise from the upper stud when looking into the mounting face. The earlier mirrored vector corresponded to the 60° variant.

The source nominal chamber/caliper interfaces agree at 120.7 mm stud pitch and M16×1.5. The model has two studs and supplied-nut references without intervening washers. Installed grip and nut access remain open.

Independent 2001-point nominal cubic checks give minimum hose radii 97.165/96.499 mm, above the recorded 45 mm minimum. Nominal hose exteriors have no retained-C5 or mutual hose intersection. Hose movement is unqualified.

The shoulder spacer, three 100 mm collars and direct rotor hub are split. The reducer is now five axial sections of two halves, with separate 110.5 mm seal-support sections. This addresses the specific monolithic stepped-reducer trap; the staged assembly and fits remain open.

open_findings.finding: Exact rotor/caliper/pad/chamber compatibility, 325.12 mm rotor versus 330 mm caliper GA, certified maximum service/spring forces and exact replacement-part availability remain upstream gates. Informational force curves do not certify a maximum force.

Chamber mating coordinate q 134.011 mm is interpreted, not controlled. It follows 129.6+28.2 sin 9° only if the identified endpoint is the upper opening edge. Exact caliper material geometry and the rotor mating-face datum remain missing.

Chamber shell transitions are idealized. The source Rmax 110 stored release-fixture/clamp protrusion exceeds the circular body and is not fully represented. Port bosses, breather locations and complete stored/released hardware need controlled CAD or the actual part.

The 43 mm stud projection is sourced, but actual caliper grip, nut seat, thread runout/protrusion and wrench approach are not established. Use supplied nuts without added washers or locking aids; supplier torque/flatness instructions govern.
SERVICE and SPRING labels at 97/116 mm stations are intended allocations only. Verify cast port identifiers and exact supplier hand code before connecting either circuit.

Flexible hose length, twist, end constraints, full 25.4 mm wear, suspension travel, captured droop, abrasion, clips and minimum bend through motion remain unqualified. The supply ends are provisional.

The 89 mm rear caging projection is sourced, but the added 50 mm tool zone is arbitrary. Clear reservations do not prove tool insertion, turning arc, hand access or the complete OEM release procedure. Nut-removal access is also open.
The pad-withdrawal box is provisional. Actual pads, retaining hardware, caliper movement and tools must establish the removal sequence.

After wheel removal, 120 mm bearing bores and 110.5 mm seal-ring bores can nominally pass the 110 mm wheel seat; the latter has only 0.5 mm diametral margin. Final tolerances, chamfers, bearing fits, segmented-reducer staging, continuous ground seal tracks and axial end clearance are unqualified.

Rotor replacement requires wheelset removal and shop removal of one wheel. The closed rotor cannot pass a 600 mm wheel in place. Pressing/removal tools, surface protection, reassembly inspections and the new axle keyway specification remain unfinished.

These discrete samples are not a continuous sweep or tolerance stack. Full rotating hardware, Ruland screw pockets, real spherical-bearing contours, thermal/elastic effects and all manufacturing tolerances remain open. Caliper and rotor-hat projections were excluded from material acceptance.

Load, fatigue and weld qualification belongs to the separate structural report. Other brake locations, handed assemblies and the complete reservoir/relay/control/parking air circuit are outside this review.

manual_review.pressure_source_rule: Exact legacy GA: 8 bar working on both circuits; 10 bar temporarily. No certified maximum output force is inferred.
manual_review.note: Manual source/assembly findings appended after the stable automatic run. The checker regenerates its raw geometric section; preserve this manual review when rerunning.
